title: Check Whether Two Trees are Isomorphic
problemStatement: Given two binary trees, determine whether one tree can be transformed into the other by swapping the left and right children of any number of nodes.
input: • The first line contains N₁. • The next N₁ lines describe the first tree. • The following line contains N₂. • The next N₂ lines describe the second tree.
output: • Print YES if the trees are isomorphic; otherwise print NO.
